chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Isma'il, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"We say that on the back of Kufa there is a grave; whoever seeks refuge with it, God will heal him."

key_terms.بِظَهْرِ الْكُوفَةِ: on the back of Kufa (a specific location)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the grave on the back of Kufa according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual efficacy of the grave located on the back of Kufa, traditionally identified as that of Imam Ali (peace be upon him), noting its unique capacity to heal any supplicant who seeks refuge there. This narration underscores the Shia belief in the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt and the sanctity of Kufa as a major center of Shi'ism, linking physical proximity to the Imam with divine cure.
